title: Pi-Style Minimalist Coding Agent Harness Architecture (Tau v0.4.4 / twotimespi)
summary: Authoritative engineering heuristics, mental models, and architectural invariants for building portable terminal coding agents. Distills the Tau repository (huggingface/tau v0.4.4) into strict 3-tier decoupling (tau_ai / tau_agent / tau_coding), immutable branchable session tree DAGs with O(N) ancestry traversal, advisory file-locked append-only JSONL journal storage, in-flight provider-safe tool history normalization, and hierarchical project-trust security perimeters.

references.description: Tau upstream repository (commit 681275b, tags v0.1.1..v0.4.4, Alejandro AO / Hugging Face)
Executable deep agent skill for Pi-style coding agent harness design
Companion summary card, 5-stage progression matrix, and invariant checklist
Tau Harness Bridge plugin documentation and IoC service specification

claims.claim: Core agent loops must maintain strict zero-dependency decoupling from CLI and TUI rendering packages to remain portable.
Conversation sessions should be modeled as immutable DAG entries with parent pointers, enabling branching without journal rewrites.
Interleaved tool call transcripts must be repaired in-flight to prevent HTTP 400 Bad Request errors across Anthropic and OpenAI.
Workspace execution requires hierarchical project trust verification to isolate sensitive credentials and SSH keys.
